english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a future outlook or the possibility of a favorable outcome.
Use this for the likely future prospects of a situation, business, or development.

examples.english: The economic prospect looks good this year.
The outlook for this new company is quite good, so it is worth investing in.
examples.traditional: 呢間新公司嘅前景幾好，值得投資。
